## About
The Hybrid Geek is a team of engineers, battery specialists and hybrid enthusiasts based on Spottswood Street in Raleigh. We replace hybrid batteries for Toyota, Lexus, Nissan, Chevrolet, GMC and Cadillac vehicles, and we bring the work to you.
You pick a battery and book a time. A technician comes to your home or workplace, installs the battery, cleans the cooling system and takes your old battery away for recycling. Then they clear the codes, take a test drive and make sure everything runs right. You pay after the job is done.
Drivers have rated us 5 stars across 793 Google reviews.

## Services
- Hybrid battery mobile installation: Installation is free. A technician comes to your home, workplace or wherever the car is parked, so there's no towing and no trip to a shop.
- Hybrid battery replacement options: Four options designed to suit different budgets, performance needs and how long you plan to keep the car.
- We clean your cooling system: Every install includes a cleaning of your hybrid battery cooling system.
- 12-volt battery replacement and mobile diagnostic services: Besides hybrid batteries, we also handle 12-volt battery replacement and diagnostics on-site.

## FAQ
Q: How long does the installation take?
A: Usually about 60 to 90 minutes, done at your home, workplace or wherever the car is.

Q: When do I pay?
A: You pay after the job is complete, once the battery is in, the codes are cleared and the test drive checks out.

Q: Do I have to pay a core deposit?
A: No. We don't charge core deposits, and we collect your old battery after the installation.

Q: Is financing available?
A: Yes. Financing is available starting from $65/mo.
